Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I am very pleased with the Spirit II.  

Positives:  

It cooks evenly - no hot or cold spots.
Both burners cook the same.

It gets very hot.  (Some reviews I had read prior to purchasing this grill said it did not get up to temperature.)  In fact, I have to have the burners turned way down, about 3/4 or more, to keep it from going over 400 degrees.

Temp setting is very sensitive.  Moving the knob just one line will change the temp by about 5 or 10 degrees. 

Preferences (I can't really call these negatives, just a wish list):

I miss the wheels on the left side.  I understand I am suppose to pick it up like a wheelbarrow, but the wheels were easier and more convenient for moving the grill.

I miss the fold-up tray extension on the left side, like I had on my 20-year-old Genesis.

I miss the old-fashioned igniter that I had on my old Genesis.  It did not need a battery.  Just push the button to create a spark.  It never failed.

It is difficult to see exactly where the temperature knobs are lined up because of their vehicle angle.  I actually have to bend down or squat down to see where they are set.  On my old Genesis, the knobs  were sitting horizontally, so were much easier to read.

My biggest complaint is the design and texture of the grates that make them really hard to clean.  They are flat and bumpy, and have a bar that runs through them from left to right.  This makes it impossible to use anything other than a wire brush to clean them.  Wire brushes are hazardous as the wire bristles can break off, stick to the grates, and get on your food, causing you to ingest them and getting lodged in your throat or digestive tract.  
These grates will not come clean using the new wooden spatulas scrapers. Nor will they come clean using a stainless steel scraper.  
I could use both these tools on my Genesis grates as they were shaped like a triangle.
In fact, does Weber offer a different set of grates similar in design as those I described on my 20-year-old Genesis?  If so. I would consider changing them out.

Overall, I do love this new grill.  It cooks wonderfully.  It is obviously well made.  And after having researched other grills, I am pleased and satisfied that I chose the Weber Spirit II.

Thank you for the opportunity to share my perspective.

Results.ReviewText:
I've enjoyed this high quality little grill for about 2 months now.  It's a keeper in every way.  Being a two burner, it didn't get at hot as my previous 4 burner grill which I thought might be a problem.  It's max temp will reach 600 degrees but that's about it.  My other one would bury the needle at 700.  We'll I don't know what it is about this little guy, but the steaks cook fantastic, just leave a few seconds longer per side,  but they are MUCH juicier.  In fact, EVERYTHING off this grill is juicier than my previous "non-Weber" gas grill.  We just grilled a "Tri-Tip" roast about a 2 pounder & wow, what a fantastically perfect medium rare roast.  I purchased the iGrill mini meat thermometer (had to special order the iGrill 3 & didn't want to wait) and watched the roast come to temperature without ever opening the grill lid.   We enjoy those frozen french mini-hard rolls with our dinners.  Normally takes 10 minutes in the oven at 400 degrees to heat up.  With this grill, throw them on the rack above the grates and no more heating up an oven for rolls.

This is my first ever weber grill.  I felt I couldn't afford them in my earlier years.  Now that I'm retired and grilling a lot more, I thought I'd treat myself.  Wow...sure wish I would have owned one of these years and years ago.  Also, this comes with a 10 year warranty which I've never heard of before.  I doubt I'll need the warranty because this thing is built like a solid horse.
Results.Title: Best little Grill EVER

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Easy to assemble, clear instructions, but give your self plenty of room to spread out the parts, there are a "fair amount" of screws and washers and assorted small items. The actual assembly took only about an hour using a power driver (hand thread all screws to make sure they are not cross threaded before using the driver to tighten). Unpacking is another thing though, Wow! every part is surrounded by cardboard or foam wrap, it another hour just to unpack, but everything was in perfect shape. This grill is quite sturdy!

Lights easily, starts to heat well but does take more time than I'm used too to reach 550 degrees (15 min.), grates are fabulous, nice sear marks. non stick and super easy to clean. Temperature control is good but I noticed that the back is a little hotter than the front, if you add items from front to back, it works out very well, the front will be done about the same time as the back. 

I've tried all the basics, burgers, hot dogs, brats, chicken breasts and even grilled zucchini (a first and it was excellent). Everything turned out very well, the chicken was the best I ever made in fifty years of grilling and I look forward to trying different recipes.  My old grill was 30 years old and was now too large for a reduced family size. Amazingly, this small grill does have enough room to cook for a small group, a dozen burgers and some Brats or hot dogs will fit. 

Love the folding shelf ! But I think you will have to be very careful if you have move the grill a long distance on rough terrain for winter storage, should have another handle 

All in all, I'm quite happy with this purchase and would highly recommend the Sprit II 210E to anyone interested in a smaller footprint grill. Treat your self to the Weber Tank Sock for a classier look !

Results.Title: Warranty

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Sears steaks perfectly, flat grate excellent for fish, shrimp. Heats up quickly. Grates clean easily with Weber brush. Best grill I’ve had in twenty years .
Results.Title: Yay for Spirit grilling!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have tried several times, following manufacturers recommendations, to heat the grill to 500 degrees.  This is to begin the process so food does not stick, and then the requirement is to reduce heat.  The last time I attempted to do this, after 35 mignonettes, the grill was at 250 degrees.  This is with a full tank and the settings wide open.  I know there is a safety feature to start low and them increase the temp.  This has been followed, but has not produced the desired outcome.
Results.Title: Grill does not reach high temps

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought it for my wife as the rental house has electric stove.  Since I cook every night on our grills, (wood, gas, charcoal) I tried the little red grill that turned out to be awesome.  It maintained heat temperature, great grill marks, plenty of room on the grate for large meat and cooked to perfection a 2.85LB tomahawk Ribeye in 35miutes maintaining 375'F She is the little Big Grill. My grill which no one touches is the Genesis II LX GS4
Results.Title: Little Big Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The Spirit II is perfect for our reduced size family during the week and for our enlarged family for weekends and holidays. Greta move for us!
Results.Title: Great replacemnet for the Genesis

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I received this as a retirement gift and it was shipped to my home via semi tractor/trailer. The legs on one side were bent requiring me to bend back in place. The grill cover also has 2 dents right down to the metal. Who ever handled this grill did not do so with the slightest care. I had to bend the cover as well just to get it opened and closed. I would have returned it but have learned it is more difficult to return then fix myself. So... I have a damaged Weber as my retirement gift. Some memories last a lifetime. This memory is not so good.
Results.Title: Damaged grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Overall, a good purchase and great grill.  Easily fits on a crowded elevated outdoor deck.  Generates more than enough heat for grilling.  Assembly was easy, except Weber had an addendum page on assembly that they FAILED to include in the assembly booklet.  After finishing, found I had two extra screws, so I began looking back through the booklet to no avail.  Then, by pure happenstance, I found it folded in half at the back of another booklet.  When I looked at the page, it became clear where they go.  Unfortunately, I had to disassemble part of the grill to install.  (Note: These two screws secured the upper grill assembly to the frame).  A lot of extra work for nothing.
Results.Title: Nice Grill, easy to assemble, but . . .

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I’ve had this a couple months now and I love it. Was worried the 2 burner would not get as hot as I wanted but that is not the case at all. May take a few minutes longer to heat up but once temp is up it’s plenty hot. Usually have to turn it down for burgers and steaks. So far so good!
Results.Title: Great Quality!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: It is easy to start and to control the heat needed. I love this grill!
Results.Title: Perfect!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
This was a gift from our daughter and son-in-law.  What a GREAT grill this is!
One of my biggest complaints is how hard grills are to clean--this one, however, is very easy to clean.
It hearts up much faster than our other grill that we had (two years).  I like the grilling chart that came with it, so we cannot turn nice steaks into "shoe leather" anymore.
PLEASE keep us updated with any accessories that might be of use, such as a "bacon" grill pan.
Results.Title: GREAT PRODUCT FOR THE COST!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
